Compared Definition 1.10 verbatim in mathematical content: smallest nonempty class, subgroup closure, directed direct/inverse limits, and torsion-free extension over elementary amenable quotient with every finite-subgroup preimage in D. The corrected version and its errata are used rather than earlier overbroad closure claims.

For rectangular A:u->v, the square off-diagonal extension kills the additional v summand, so its kernel dimension is dim ker A+v. Cellular boundary matrices are integral and hence rational. Hilbert rank-nullity uses closure of image, giving b_i=k_i+k_(i+1)-c_(i+1), an integer and nonnegative; no asphericity assumption on X is needed.

The trivial group lies in every nonempty subgroup-closed class. A torsion-free elementary amenable Q has no nontrivial finite subgroup; the identity quotient puts Q in D. Separating such quotients embeds a residually such G in their product. Finite products, inverse limit of finite-coordinate products, and subgroup closure justify the entire residual step. Proposition 1.13 supplies free/direct products and free-group inputs.
